mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE below 4.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When both GDPC1 (GDP growth) and HOUST (demand activity) show upward trends over 3 months, it signals robust demand expansion, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: Both GDPC1 and HOUST show upward trends over 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and HOUST trend upward.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (rising FEDFUNDS), higher interest rates compress equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: In tightening cycles, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS rises.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in the INDPRO supply index above 105.0 suggests overproduction or weak demand, reducing corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO crosses above 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly increases in PAYEMS (payroll employment) indicate a strengthening labor market, enhancing corporate profits and equity returns, leading to positive 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when PAYEMS trends upward.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward trends in GDPC1 (GDP growth) and RSAFS (retail sales) signal robust demand expansion, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: Both GDPC1 and RSAFS show upward trends over 3 months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and RSAFS trend upward.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply shock regime, a decline in INDPRO below 100 indicates normalization of supply pressures, easing market overhang and boosting equity returns, leading to positive 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: supply shock regime with INDPRO below 100
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO drops below 100 in a supply shock regime.
